verdicts.why: Team X appears in TAS only in flashback ('Red Dawn', 'Weapon X, Lies, and Video Tape' list Team X as FlashOnly) and had disbanded after the Russia mission; Wolverine re-forms it with Sabretooth, Deathstrike and Morph in X-Men '97 S2 episode 5, and the Team X page lists him as a current member.

The Marvel Database names the Sandstormers plainly (Baal's raiders) and lists them as his former affiliation; he rides with them on screen in X-Men '97 S2 episode 3 until Rama-Tut's strike kills them all, and the Horsemen come later, so Horsemen stays last.

He does end with the X-Men (current affiliation), but the return comes in X-Men '97 S1 episode 10, which the episode's cast list tags as Magneto 'Rejoins' the X-Men when Xavier breaks through; S2 only continues it, so the stage belongs to X-Men '97 S1.

The X-Men '97 S1 episode 10 appearance is a cameo guarding a Russian official; the Winter Guard is never named on screen, has no Earth-92131 page, and the dataset uses no such group. He is still serving the Russian state as before, so this is unsure and the record stays as it is.

In TAS S2 episode 10 his men abandon him once he is exposed as Sabretooth's son and the FoH carries on without him; in 'Bloodlines' the council takes him back on condition and he works their trap with FoH resources, so FoH, Independent, FoH holds.
He lives on Genosha as a Genoshan in X-Men '97 S1 episode 5 (the dataset tracks Genosha's residents, e.g. Callisto, Madelyne, Emma), and leads the Acolytes in S2.

In What If...? S1 episode 9 he turns on the Guardians to take the Stones and attacks them before he is sealed away, which is a defection; the Marvel Database lists the Guardians as a former affiliation.

The MCU wiki says Scarlet Witch and Vision had both left the Avengers by 2018, before the outbreak, and in What If...? episode 5 she is only a zombie in Vision's cell, so her Avengers membership is backstory.

The only thing that separates him from Hammer Industries on screen is prison, and prison is not a move. The episode never shows him losing the company, and the wiki's '(formerly)' is not enough to go on, so the unsure case keeps what's there.
His HYDRA and CIA work is told as backstory in his one appearance, FATWS episode 3 (HYDRA disbanded, the CIA dropped the program after the Blip). On screen he is in Madripoor on Power Broker funding.

His Army service was in WWI, 15 years before the show. In episode 1 he is a hireling of Cat Hardy who burns Silvermane's mansion, is hunted by Silvermane's men and is killed by Donegal, so he is in no group on screen.
His S.H.I.E.L.D. service and T.A.H.I.T.I. treatment ended with a memory wipe and new identity before the series. In AoS S2 he is a former agent hunting the other patients and ends in custody.
His Soviet Armed Forces service (478th Regiment, Finow) was WWII backstory. In Agent Carter S1 he is only a Leviathan assassin.

In AoS S3 'The Team' he agrees to work with S.H.I.E.L.D., betrays and renounces HYDRA and gives up every base before Daisy kills him, which is a defection. He is an informant, not an agent, so the stage is Independent.

He was out of PRIDE (memory wiped by the Synnergy Serum) before the series. The wiki says outright that in the present he 'was not part of PRIDE' and Jonah 'had thrown him out'. He leads the Church until the adepts turn on him and lock him up in S2.
